title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: The Range Busters
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, John King, Max Terhune) make their cowboy-trio debut, hunting a phantom killer.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: Fast Bullets
description: Two Texas Rangers (Tom Tyler, Rex Lease) nab smugglers and rescue a woman (Margaret Nearing) from a runaway wagon.

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Bad Man of Deadwood
description: A cowboy (Roy Rogers) hides from his past in a fake professor's (George "Gabby" Hayes) medicine show and helps town outcasts fight civic reformers.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Rawhide
description: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: Leather Burners
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) helps his friend Johnny (Jay Kirby) find out where rustlers are hiding stolen cattle.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Singing Billy (Roy Rogers) settles a case of mistaken identity with his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette).

title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
description: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

title: Cry Blood, Apache
description: An old man (Joel McCrea) recalls his days as a young man (Jody McCrea) fighting Indians in the Old West.

title: Enemy of the Law
description: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

title: Six-Gun Trail
description: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Blue Steel
description: Marshal John Carruthers helps a sheriff find out who stole the town's payroll, and together they discover the town's leader stole the money to buy up all the land.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: Death Valley
description: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Rawhide Rangers
description: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: New Mexico
description: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: Heartland
description: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

title: Under California Stars
description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers.

title: Yellowneck
description: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

title: Hurricane Horseman
description: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: One-Eyed Jacks
description: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
description: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

title: Arizona Thunderbolt
description: A circus performer (Joe Cook) and his piano-playing partner (Robert Cummings) go after a pair of ruthless rustlers.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E25 — Safe Crackers
Pat and Stoney are ordered to break up a safe cracking gang preying on Colorado banks handling government silver bullion.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E26 — Silver Fraud
US mint has been buying silver diluted with lead; Pat and Scotty set out to find the criminals.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E27 — Hangfire
Matt must restore order to a town controlled by outlaws.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E28 — Hush Money
Pat and Stoney investigate a land title dispute.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E06 — Please Buy My Violets
Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E07 — The Ringer
Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E08 — Kate's Recipe for Hot Rhubarb
Kate decides it is time for Betty Jo to put down the books and set out to find a significant other.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E09 — The Little Train Robbery
A pair of crooks plans to rob the Cannonball of its bank shipment.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E13 — The Hardrock Trail
Outlaw Vic Carver (Robert B. Williams) seeks revenge against Sheriff MacTavish (Kenneth MacDonald) for sending him to jail.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E15 — Justice Guns
Annie (Gail Davis) races to save her retired mentor (Stanley Andrews) from a suicide mission with a merciless young gunman. With Ric Vallin.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E23 — Sharpshooting Annie
Annie and Tagg (Gail Davis, Jimmy Hawkins) track a masked bandit who holds up an acrobatic troupe. With Brad Johnson.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E24 — Annie Makes a Marriage
Annie (Gail Davis) plays matchmaker for her friend Bess Murdock (Nancy Hale). With Don Kennedy, Brad Johnson.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E25 — Outlaw Mesa
Annie relies on Tagg's ability as a ventriloquist to save an innocent stage driver from angry townspeople.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S02 E03 — The Runaways
Tagg (Jimmy Hawkins) and his friend Billy (Stuffy Singer) run away to a ghost town inhabited by an outlaw gang. With Gail Davis.
